---
name: review-lanes
description: Coordinate independent review lanes and synthesize the available evidence.
engine: 0.2.0-lab.1
roles: [lead, reviewers]
extensions: [host.presence/1, room.contributions/1]
---
"""
Ask independent agents to examine the same change from their assigned perspectives.
Collect their evidence even when a lane cannot finish. Missing coverage must be
visible in the synthesis; receiving reports does not establish that a change is safe.
"""
contract @30m max @4h => expired

"""
Choose the participants and their lane guidance before starting this run.
Give every reviewer the same immutable change and sufficient context. In the
summary, distinguish observed findings, disagreements and missing coverage.
"""
role lead

"""
Work independently within your assigned lane. Cite evidence for actionable
findings, state uncertainty and avoid presenting missing evidence as a clean review.
Use the room's stop_contribution operation if you must stop your contribution.
A heartbeat is evidence of activity, not a result.
"""
type reviewer: agent
  """
  Name the perspective this participant should bring to the review.
  """
  specialty: enum(devops|security|frontend|general)

"""
Bind the independent reviewers for this run; each follows its type and assignment.
"""
reviewers: list(reviewer)

"""
The shared review request every lane answers.
"""
type request
  """
  Identify the immutable change and the question the review should answer.
  """
  text: text(1..4000)

"""
One lane's report on the shared request.
"""
type review
  """
  Report evidence, scope checked and uncertainty, including a clean result when appropriate.
  """
  text: text(1..8000)

"""
I am still working on my lane. It renews the collection window; it is not a report.
"""
type heartbeat

"""
The lead's synthesis: supported findings, disagreements and missing coverage.
"""
type summary
  text: text(1..8000)

/* Author note: the roster size is a runtime choice, not a number in this skill.
   The recipient ceiling above is a resource bound; it does not require 256 agents. */
"""
Only the lead starts the shared review request.
"""
state new
  lead -> reviewers: request() => reviewing

"""
Preserve independent reports. Do not wait beyond the collection window for an
unresponsive lane. The room applies the declared grace to trusted presence data.
"""
state reviewing
  """
  Renew this exact collection window while preserving reports already received.
  """
  event reviewers -> lead: heartbeat() => @self
  """
  Continue when all lanes settle, or return the available reports at the deadline.
  """
  collect reports from reviewers -> lead @5m => summarizing
    reply review()
    offline @30s

"""
Read the collection results and accepted reports. Combine supported findings,
identify disagreement, and name failed, offline or timed-out lanes explicitly.
Partial coverage is useful evidence, but it is not proof of complete coverage.
"""
state summarizing
  lead -> reviewers: summary() => complete

"""
A summary was delivered; its quality and any release decision require evaluation.
"""
end complete

---
name: renewable-work
description: Keep a long-running job alive through explicit heartbeats under an absolute cap.
engine: 0.2.0-lab.1
roles: [lead, worker]
---
"""
The worker may renew its activity window, but the run cannot pass its creation-anchored four hours.
"""
contract @4h => expired

"""
Assign one well-defined job and wait for the result. Heartbeats show activity;
they are not progress you can rely on.
"""
role lead

"""
Complete the assigned work and provide honest progress evidence.
"""
role worker

"""
The job, its acceptance criteria and any context the worker needs.
"""
type request
  text: text(1..2000)

"""
I am still working. Send it only while you are, never to hold the session open.
"""
type heartbeat

"""
The finished work, or what you could not finish and why. Set request to the request this
answers.
"""
type result
  request: ref(request)
  text: text(1..4000)

"""
The lead assigns the job.
"""
state new
  """
  Assign the job. The worker then owes one result.
  """
  lead -> worker: request() awaits working
    """
    Deliver the result before the activity window closes.
    """
    => result() & complete
     """
     Eighty minutes passed without a result or a heartbeat.
     """
     | @80m & stalled

"""
Only the explicitly declared event renews the activity window.
"""
state working
  """
  Send a heartbeat only while you are working; it gives you another eighty minutes, never past the
  four-hour contract clock.
  """
  event worker -> lead: heartbeat() => @self

"""
The worker delivered a result; the lead still checks it against the criteria.
"""
end complete

"""
The worker went quiet for eighty minutes. Reassign the job in a new session.
"""
end stalled
